_comment: Example hooks.json for the zero-trust mock. Copy to <APP_CONFIG_DIR>/hooks.json. The policy URL is passed as argv because hooks do not inherit the server environment and copy hook_client.py to <APP_CONFIG_DIR>/hooks/ (chmod +x). Start the policy server first -- PreToolUse fails closed, so an unreachable server denies every tool call: python mocks/zero-trust-mock/main.py. Note UserPromptSubmit has no approval gate, so a require_approval verdict there is treated as continue; only deny stops a prompt.
